thesis: Twenty-six adversarial rounds each finding a CONFIRMED laundering vector is not evidence the gate is over-built; it is evidence the adversary is real and lives in-house. In a lights-out factory the agents ARE the threat model, and every mechanical exemption predicate in the current spec ultimately grounds in agent-authored data: the clerk (an agent) writes the fingerprint:, location:, and source-pr: trailers the bindings verify against; the #649 backfill audit (agent-performed) normalizes the very locations the hunk-overlap check trusts; the release-captain (an agent) self-acknowledges reports with no floored exemptions; and the 'Human maintainers' roster that anchors the two-principal rule is itself a plain file in MAINTAINERS.md that agents author PRs against and — per this factory's own standing 'merge autonomously' policy — merge without a human. A permissive-by-mechanism gate is therefore a closed loop of agent-generated evidence checking agent-generated evidence, and it will ALWAYS have a 27th hole; we can name a live candidate today (roster injection via an autonomously-merged MAINTAINERS.md edit). The only trust anchor outside any agent's reach is a cryptographic human signature verified by GitHub's signature API against a chain-of-custody roster. So the correct simplification is not fewer rules but a stricter default: NO close of a gate-relevant issue is ever trusted mechanically; every exemption requires the human-signed witness; the mechanical bindings are kept — all of them — but demoted from sufficient trust decisions to hard NECESSARY preconditions plus evidence assembly that makes the human's witness a 30-second-per-row check instead of an investigation. This is cheap at real release cadence: ONE signed ack commit per release attempt covers the entire exemption ledger, and the ledger at steady state is a handful of rows.
design: THE SINGLE RULE (universal witness): the Release Gate script enumerates every close of a gate-relevant issue at/after the 2026-07-29 baseline into an exemption ledger inside gate-report.json (canonical JSON, SHA-256 over exact bytes, per the existing #934/#938/#952 mechanism). If the ledger is non-empty, the gate FAILS unless a commit on the release branch adds factory-ops/release/<version>/exemptions.ack whose only line is that SHA-256 digest, where the commit's verified-signature state is VALID, signature.signer.login (never the settable author/committer email, #1080) is on the Human-maintainers roster, and author, committer, and signer all resolve to that same account. One ack, one signature event, covers the whole ledger for that release attempt. No floor-label condition selects who witnesses: the human witnesses everything, always.

SIGNATURE IS NECESSARY, NEVER SUFFICIENT: every mechanical binding remains a hard per-row precondition that no signature can override — humans get fatigued and phished, and inbound issue text is untrusted; a signed lie is still a lie. A ledger row must still pass: stateReason=completed with a qualifying merged change (closedByPullRequestsReferences merged PR, or the #894 remediation commit on the default branch naming issue+fingerprint); non-empty diff under whitespace-ignoring comparison; fingerprint cited in immutable evidence only (default-branch squash commit message, #941); the anchored location grammar (#997) with hunk overlap in the recorded line +/-20 in OLD-file coordinates, deletion OR insertion form (#942/#1031/#923); or the duplicate path via most-recent MarkedAsDuplicateEvent, transitive to a terminal gate-relevant target with floor inheritance (#939), fail-closed on cycles. A row that fails its bindings BLOCKS and cannot be signed into exemption — the cure is the #894 remediation path or reopening the issue, never an override.

SET MEMBERSHIP UNCHANGED: gate-relevance stays exactly as spec'd — ever-carried timeline membership for bug/tech-debt/security/gate:confirmed-high (#887), interval-computed P0/P1 presence in [2026-07-29, close] from LabeledEvent/UnlabeledEvent intervals not event dates (#922), fail-closed triage on unlabeled tech-debt, the gate:confirmed-high ever-carried open criterion, and mandatory down-rank visibility in the same hash-acknowledged report (#909). These define WHAT the single rule applies to; they are the part 26 rounds hardened and they cost nothing to keep.

NEW CRITERION — ROSTER CHAIN-OF-CUSTODY (closes the named candidate 27th hole): the synthesis ADR pins the 2026-07-29 'Human maintainers' roster (list + hash recorded in the ADR). The gate script walks the commit history of MAINTAINERS.md from that baseline to the release-branch tip; every commit that changes the Human-maintainers section must itself carry a VALID verified signature whose signer.login was on the roster as of that commit's parent. Any unsigned, agent-signed, or non-roster-signed roster change fails the gate. Without this, the two-principal rule's trust root is agent-writable and the whole witness scheme is theater.

COLLAPSED ACKNOWLEDGMENT TIERS: gateReportHash in .factory/state/release-intent.json (the release-captain's fenced write) is retained as machine bookkeeping that the captain produced and reviewed the report — but it never suffices for exemptions. The clause 'reports with no floored exemptions need only the release-captain's acknowledgment' is deleted: the captain is a factory agent; an agent acknowledging the machinery's own output is precisely the self-certification the gate exists to forbid.

DATA REQUIREMENTS OF THE SINGLE RULE, exhaustively: per close — issue number; full paginated LabeledEvent/UnlabeledEvent timeline; stateReason; closedByPullRequestsReferences filtered to merged; the squash commit message as it exists on the default branch; PR diff hunks with old-file coordinates; issue-body trailers (fingerprint:, location:, source-pr:); MarkedAsDuplicateEvent chain. Per release — MAINTAINERS.md section history with per-commit signature verification (GraphQL commit signature: state + signer.login); the exemptions.ack bytes; the canonical gate-report.json bytes and digest. Everything except the roster-history walk is ALREADY required by the current spec. The single rule adds one query and deletes two conditional branches — it is net-simpler while strictly stronger.

PREREQUISITES UNCHANGED: #419/#420 (paginated counting), #510 (triage), #511 (eval thresholds), #649 (backfill: trailer + location normalization) remain a mechanical closed-state criterion, satisfiable by construction (#925). The bindings stay hard, so #649's normalization work is still required — but its output is no longer silently load-bearing for trust, because a human witnesses every exemption its normalized data enables; an agent-corrupted backfill can at worst present evidence a human must still sign.
kept_mechanisms: Ever-carried timeline set membership for bug/tech-debt/security/gate:confirmed-high (#887) — defeats strip-then-close
Interval label-presence for P0/P1 in [baseline, close], computed as intervals not event dates (#922) — defeats re-rank-then-close
Fail-closed triage criterion (untriaged tech-debt blocks; legacy labels don't count)
gate:confirmed-high as an ever-carried timeline query with clerk-applied filing-time floor
Duplicate exemption: most-recent MarkedAsDuplicateEvent, transitive resolution, fail-closed on cycles/non-termination
Floor inheritance across duplicates (#939) — defeats duplicate-onto-fresh-P1-then-downrank
Fingerprint binding to immutable evidence only: default-branch squash commit message, never the editable PR body (#941)
Anchored full-string location grammar (#997) and hunk-overlap +/-20 in old-file coordinates, deletion or insertion form (#942/#1031/#923)
source-pr: trailer as a mandatory clerk field and ledger provenance column (#995)
No-PR-link remediation branch: later default-branch commit naming issue+fingerprint (#894) — the only cure for a failed binding, never an override
Signer-verified identity: signature.state VALID, signer.login on the roster, author==committer==signer, anchored bot regex not glob (#1080/#1014/#1015)
Hash-acknowledged canonical-JSON gate report; unproducible, stale, or unacknowledged report fails the gate (#934/#938/#952)
Fully-paginated queries everywhere; prerequisite issues as a closed-state check, satisfiable by construction (#925)
Down-rank visibility: every post-baseline P0/P1 -> P2/P3 re-rank named in the report (#909)
ops-state ack path (factory-ops/release/<version>/) so no guard-scope fence widens
cut_mechanisms: Floor-conditional second principal (human witness only when an exemption touches ever-carried security/gate:confirmed-high, #996/#1081) — superseded: the witness is now universal, so the condition, its floor-vs-self-ack sub-case, and its entire decision tree vanish.

The 'reports with no floored exemptions need only the release-captain's gateReportHash acknowledgment' clause — deleted: the captain is a factory agent; agent self-acknowledgment of agent output is the pattern the gate forbids.

The same-PR equality dual-branch (#1082: STRICT-location + human witness only when qualifying PR == source-pr) — redundant: every exemption now carries the independent witness, so anti-self-certification holds universally and the special branch (and its permanent-false-red worry) dissolves; source-pr survives as a provenance column, not a rule selector.

The heuristic-floor tier as a SUFFICIENT trust decision for no-fingerprint issues (merged non-empty-diff PR alone exempted them) — demoted: it remains the minimum binding but never exempts without the signature; a mechanical trust decision over agent-authored data is exactly what we stop making.

The standing waiver prose for near-line cosmetic-insertion residual risk ('rides the hash-acknowledged report') — no waived class remains: that residual is now precisely the thing the human witness exists to catch, row by row.

The #953 framing that residual human judgment applies only to the down-rank-and-floored-exemption subset — replaced by one sentence: the human witnesses every exemption; the pass/fail computation remains fully mechanical (presence and validity of the signed ack).
migration: PR #444 lands under this as follows. (1) The panel's synthesis ADR (next number) records the decision; per GOVERNANCE.md's joint-lane rule the architect authors the spec wording, the product owner keeps the PRODUCT.md rationale pointing at the spec — ADR 0005 itself is untouched, since its scope decision (severity-scoped, fail-closed, security cross-priority, M5 deferral home) is orthogonal to how exemptions are witnessed. (2) #444 is rebased once onto main; the spec's 'Release Gate for v1.0.0' close-laundering paragraph is replaced wholesale with the synthesized text — net SMALLER: two conditional branches and the two-tier ack deleted, one universal-witness sentence and one roster-custody criterion added. (3) The sprint-4 review freeze holds: no further adversarial rounds on #444; the panel ADR is the review of record; #444 merges when the suite is green, ending the loop that grew the backlog 2.6x in a week. (4) The ~465 findings filed against superseded drafts route to #649's backfill audit for disposition; those closed as design-superseded appear in the FIRST release's exemption ledger and are witnessed in one signed ack — the one-time, on-the-record cost of the review-loop incident, paid exactly once. (5) The M4 Release Gate script implements the predicate: for every gate-relevant close, bindings_pass(close) must hold AND the close must appear as a ledger row; gate passes only if (ledger empty) OR (valid roster-signed exemptions.ack matches sha256(gate-report.json)); plus the roster chain-of-custody walk. (6) /ship wiring keeps its shape: the captain writes gateReportHash after review; the human operator commits exemptions.ack when the ledger is non-empty — no fence changes, both write paths already sanctioned.
risks_accepted: Human availability becomes a hard release dependency: a release with any gate-relevant close blocks until the operator signs. Accepted deliberately — a lights-out factory that can exempt its own findings without any human is exactly the threat model, and GOVERNANCE.md already names the human operator as a principal.

Rubber-stamp risk: a fatigued operator may sign a large ledger without reading it. Mitigated (not eliminated) by keeping every binding as a hard pre-filter so only consistent evidence bundles ever reach the human, and by the one-time-large/steady-state-small ledger shape; the residual is accepted and is still strictly smaller than the current design's agent-self-ack path.

False-block friction: a legitimately-fixed, hand-closed issue with broken trailers blocks until cured via the #894 remediation commit or reopening — signature cannot override a failed binding. Accepted: the cure paths are cheap and honest, and an override lane would be the softest laundering path in the gate.

First-release ledger is large (the #980 review-loop blowup plus design-superseded findings), making the first witness session genuinely expensive. Accepted as a one-time cost that is also an honest audit of the incident.

Roster chain-of-custody bootstraps from a pinned 2026-07-29 baseline recorded in the ADR; if that pin were wrong the trust root is wrong. Accepted — same baseline-pinning precedent the close-laundering criterion already uses, and the pin is human-reviewed in the synthesis ADR itself.
This stance spends spec complexity on security and pays in operator ceremony and implementer surface; it does not optimize for contract minimalism or DX, and says so openly.
